concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-payment-methods-rakutenpay-flutter-drop-in]] — 2026-09-15 Rakuten Pay Flutter Drop-in Sessions (Checkout API v68+) and Advanced redirect add-on with review-gated recurring model claims and DGFT TEST simulator; Sessions prerequisite link points to Advanced.
warnings: Recurring prose permits one-off card-on-file only after review under stated business-model conditions, prohibits the card-on-file model without periodic cadence, and requires an application for every Recurring Processing Model; consent is strongly recommended, not stated as an unconditional requirement.
The Sessions integration-type link points to Advanced flow; do not silently use it as a Sessions setup route.
TEST simulator/account instructions do not establish a live enablement procedure or actual payment outcome.
